en.title: Nine marathon attempts. A new focus.
en.excerpt: A running story does not have to fit neatly into a list of finish times. Mine eventually turned towards 10 km.
en.body:
## More than a finish time

The easiest way to tell a running story is with a distance and a result. Mine needs a little more room. It includes nine marathon attempts, followed by a later focus on 10 km. That change is part of the story, too.

## A different chapter

I started running with a weight-loss goal for karting and motorsport. Marathons became part of the journey. Later, my attention turned to a shorter distance. The distance changed; running remained part of my life.

## Beyond the distance

Founding Rocca Sörk added a shared chapter. Working remotely in digital marketing and running whenever I travel added another.

This journal holds those chapters together. The marathon attempts belong here, alongside the 10 km focus and the runs that happen between work and exploring somewhere new.

et.title: Üheksa maratonikatset. Uus fookus.
et.excerpt: Jooksulugu ei pea mahtuma finišiaegade tabelisse. Minu tee viis lõpuks 10 km distantsini.
et.body:
## Rohkem kui finišiaeg

Jooksulugu on kõige lihtsam jutustada distantsi ja tulemuse kaudu. Minu oma vajab veidi rohkem ruumi. Selles on üheksa maratonikatset ja hilisem keskendumine 10 km distantsile. Ka see muutus on osa loost.

## Teistsugune peatükk

Hakkasin jooksma sooviga kardisõidu ja motospordi nimel kaalu langetada. Maratonid said osaks teekonnast. Hiljem pöördus tähelepanu lühemale distantsile. Distants muutus, jooksmine jäi.

## Distantsist kaugemale

Rocca Sörgi asutamine lisas ühise jooksu peatüki. Kaugtöö digiturunduses ja reisidel jooksmine tõid järgmise.

See päevik seob need peatükid kokku. Maratonikatsed kuuluvad siia samamoodi nagu 10 km fookus ning jooksud, mis mahuvad töö ja uute paikade avastamise vahele.
